changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: Add TRANSACT_FROM_TS and TRANSACT_TO_TS to BT.STRATEGY (nullable initially for backfill)
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE BT.STRATEGY ADD COLUMN TRANSACT_FROM_TS TIMESTAMPTZ; ALTER TABLE BT.STRATEGY ADD COLUMN TRANSACT_TO_TS TIMESTAMPTZ;

changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: Backfill: TRANSACT_FROM_TS = CREATED_AT; active rows get 9999-12-31, closed rows get CREATED_AT
changeSet.sql: UPDATE BT.STRATEGY SET TRANSACT_FROM_TS = CREATED_AT, TRANSACT_TO_TS = CASE WHEN IS_CURRENT_IND = 'Y' THEN TIMESTAMPTZ '9999-12-31 00:00:00+00' ELSE CREATED_AT END;

changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: Make TRANSACT columns NOT NULL after backfill, then drop IS_CURRENT_IND

changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: SP_INS_STRATEGY: close prior row via TRANSACT_TO_TS instead of IS_CURRENT_IND flip

changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: SP_GET_STRATEGY: filter on TRANSACT_TO_TS = 9999-12-31 instead of IS_CURRENT_IND

changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: FN_GET_QUEUE_FOR_TERMINAL: drop STRAT_CURRENT_IND from RETURNS TABLE and SELECT
